correctness.rationale: For a labelled nontrivial Steiner triple system v>=7, the complementary 3-subset matroid bases have N=v(v-1)(v-3)/6, uniform point degree d=(v-1)(v-3)/2, pair codegree c=v-3. Exact expansion of each sign ∏_{i in B}(1-2 1_S(i)) gives W(S)=N-2|S|d+4 binom(|S|,2)c-8 #bases wholly contained S. The v mod8 residue class gives W≡4 (mod8) for v≡5,7, and W≡0 for v≡1,3, using all odd admissible orders. Thus all Fourier characters have nonzero integer eigenvalues of absolute value >=4 in first branch; unnormalized convolution has rank 2^v, inverse ℓ² norm<=1/4 and determinant v2=2^(v+1). A two-point frequency at v=9 is zero. Independent integer incidence arithmetic checked v7,9,13,15; source checker builds five designs and full Walsh spectra. No universal singularity is inferred in the divisible-by-eight branch.
